infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PROOVRA uses the camera only when you capture a photo or video as evidence.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PROOVRA uses the microphone only when you record audio or video as evidence.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PROOVRA reads your photo library only when you choose an existing photo or video to submit as evidence.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PROOVRA can attach your location to evidence you capture, only when you consent at capture time.
